content.short: One Zelcore login works on desktop, mobile and browser, holding assets across 80+ chains with swaps built in.
content.description: Zelcore runs on Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS and Android, and as a Chrome or Edge extension, all under one login. It holds a very wide range of assets across more than 80 chains, with in-app swaps, staking and buying. Ledger and Trezor devices can be connected, and optional decentralized two-factor authentication adds another layer. Zelcore says it stores no user data. Its integrated exchanges offer more than 1,200 swap pairs, and the wallet also supports node management for advanced users.
content.meta: Self-custody wallet for every major platform, covering 80+ chains with swaps, staking and hardware support. Explore Zelcore on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
